_crawl.about: Brown & Brown delivers risk management solutions to help protect and preserve what our customers value most. Our two business segments, Retail and Specialty Distribution, offer businesses and individuals a wide range of insurance solutions. We are one of the insurance industry’s most powerful and influential leaders, with a strong, deeply rooted cultural foundation built on integrity, innovation, superior capabilities and discipline. The Power of WE ignites our performance, and while diverse and varied in abilities and experience, we are all connected through our core values, a commitment to our local communities and a shared mission—always doing what is best for our customers. Brown & Brown is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, and we are always actively looking for talented teammates who embrace our culture to join our winning team. Find us on the NYSE as BRO. Brown & Brown Legal Entities: https://linktr.ee/brownbrowninc

## Comparing auto insurance quotes is easy

One of the best ways to save money on car insurance is to compare quotes. Prices can vary by
hundreds of dollars among companies, so time spent getting prices can really pay off.

It's easy to get quotes. EverQuote can match you to insurers that best fit you. And auto insurance
quotes are free - no matter who you get them from.

## Types of car insurance

It's good to have an idea of what kinds of auto insurance you want when you're ready to compare car
insurance quotes. Here are the main coverage types.

**Liability insurance.** This is required in most states and is the foundation of auto insurance
policies. Liability coverage pays others for accidents you cause, including injuries and property
damage. Note that liability insurance does not cover any damage to your own car.

**Collision insurance.** This pays for damage to your car if you hit something, such as a pole or
tree.

**Comprehensive insurance.** This pays out if your car is stolen. It also covers damage to you car
if you hit an animal or if you have damage from flood, fire, hail, vandalism or falling objects
(such as a tree branch).

**Uninsured motorist (UM) insurance.** If you're injured by a driver who has no liability insurance,
this coverage pays medical bills. In some states you can also buy a version that covers car damage
from an uninsured motorist.

**Personal injury protection (PIP) and medical payments (MedPay) coverage.** These pay for injuries
of you and your passengers, no matter who was at fault. Some states require PIP, where it is
sometimes called "no-fault insurance."

**Rental reimbursement insurance.** If your car is in the shop due to an accident covered by your
policy, this helps pay for a rental car. It typically has a daily and total maximum that it will
pay.

## How much auto insurance do you want?

Before you set out to compare car insurance, have an idea of what levels of coverage you want. The
minimum you must buy will be decided by your state. State requirements can include liability
insurance, uninsured motorist coverage, and personal injury protection (called PIP or no-fault). You
may want higher coverage levels for each than what's required.

Here are examples of levels of coverage for liability and uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage.
Your own car insurance needs often depend on how many assets you would have at risk in a lawsuit
against you after a car crash. It also depends on whether you want insurance that will pay out for
damage such as hail, hitting a fence or having your car stolen.

**Highest Level**
* $250,000 per person/ $500,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $100,000 property damage liability
* $250,000 per person/ $500,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Typical Level**
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $50,000 property damage liability
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Lower Level**
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $25,000 property damage liability
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Minimum level (state requirements might be higher)**
* $15,000 per person / $30,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $5,000 property damage liability
* $15,000 per person/ $30,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

* $100,000 property damage liability
* $250,000 per person/ $500,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Typical Level**
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $50,000 property damage liability
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Lower Level**
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $25,000 property damage liability
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

* $15,000 per person/ $30,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

## What's full coverage car insurance?

You may have heard the term "full coverage car insurance." It generally refers to a policy that has
liability, collision and comprehensive coverage. That gives you insurance for damage and injuries
you cause others (liability), and damage to your own car and theft (collision and comprehensive).

## How much will auto insurance cost?

The average premium paid for full coverage is about $138 a month, based on premiums reported by
EverQuote users. That's based on good drivers with the "typical" level of coverage shown above.

Of course you can spend less by buying less coverage, but you might regret it later if you're in an
accident.

## How car insurance quotes are calculated

Rates can vary quite a bit when you compare car insurance because insurance companies all have their
own way of calculating prices. Still, here are factors generally used in auto insurance quotes:

**The drivers.** Age and driving experience affect quotes. So do moving violations such as speeding
tickets. This includes all the licensed drivers in your household.

**Past claims and accidents.** Having caused accidents and made claims will usually mean higher
rates.

**How the vehicle is used and where it's parked. ** Do you use the vehicle for personal or business
reasons? Where is it parked at night? These typically affect car insurance quotes.

**Credit.** Poor credit can mean higher auto insurance rates. The insurance industry correlates poor
credit to a higher chance that a driver will make a claim. This practice is banned in California,
Hawaii and Massachusetts.

**The vehicle.** Insurers often use data on past claims on a vehicle like yours to calculate car
insurance quotes. If other drivers of your model have made a lot of claims, or the vehicle is
expensive to repair, that can be reflected in a car insurance quote.

# A Temporary Health Insurance Plan Is Easy To Obtain And Provides Coverage You Can Afford.

Don’t wait! Make an affordable choice and protect your health with Flex Term short-term medical
insurance.

[START HERE][6]

# What Is Short-Term Health Insurance Used For?

Short-term health insurance is your *lifeline* during gaps in coverage—whether you’re between jobs,
transitioning off a parent’s plan, or waiting for open enrollment. The Flex Term Health Insurance
Plan offers you fast, flexible protection when you need it most.

With premiums designed to be budget-friendly, these plans deliver essential medical coverage without
breaking the bank.

Coverage can start as soon as tomorrow and you can cancel anytime without penalties. 

## Who Uses Temporary Health Insurance?
* Individuals who missed the deadlines for the ACA exchanges and need to wait until the next
  enrollment period
* Individuals who have a waiting period before enrollment in another program
* People who need health insurance in between jobs or have been laid off
* [People looking for a less expensive COBRA health insurance alternative][7]
* Those needing temporary coverage:
  * College students or recent graduates
  * Young adults coming off their parent’s health benefit plan
  * Retirees waiting for Medicare eligibility
  * Coverage for dependents not covered under an employer plan

#### Quick Coverage, Flexible Plans

Find short-term health insurance plans for less. Keep yourself safe with temporary health coverage.

[See Plans][8]
[Person looking at plans on a laptop][Person looking at plans on a laptop]

### Flex Term Health Insurance Plan Options²
* Deductible options ($1,000, $2,500, $5,000, $7,500, or $10,000)
* Co-pay : $50
* Co-insurance options (50/50, 70/30, 80/20, or 100/0)
* Coverage period maximum ($250,000, $750,000, $1,000,000, or $1,500,000)
* Length of coverage options
* Eligibility 18-64 years old (child only coverage for ages 2-25)
* Monthly or pre-pay payment options
* Free-look period

[Start Here][9]

Office Visit Copays Are $50

FlexTerm short-term health insurance is currently available in:
AL, AZ, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MS, MO, NE, NV, NC, OH, OK, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, VA, WV, WI, and
WY

## How Does Flex Term Temporary Health Insurance Work?

FIRST

 

$50 copay for physician office visit
$50 copay for annual wellness exam

THEN

 

Cover your deductible of $1000, $2500, $5000, $7500 or $10,000
Your deductible is the amount you must pay before FlexTerm Health Insurance pays benefits.

Coinsurance Options:
* 50%/50% – You pay 50% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 70%/30% – You pay 30% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 80%/20% – You pay 20% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 100% – We pay 100% of the covered charges up to the plan maximum

AFTER

**FlexTerm Health pays all remaining covered charges, up to the Policy Period Maximum.**

## Flex Term Health Insurance Highlights
* Plans available up to 12 months*
* 5 minute simple applaication process
* Flexibility to choose your own physician and hospitals
* Next Day Coverage

* Some states may vary

[Provider Search][10]

## Summary of Coverages
* Wellness
* Inpatient/Outpatient Surgery
* Hospital Benefits
* Emergency Room Care
* Outpatient Services
* X-Ray and Laboratory
* Transplant Benefits
* Urgent Care
* Sickness

### About The Carrier

[Everest Reinsurance Company Logo 2022][Everest Reinsurance Company Logo 2022]

Everest Re Group Ltd. is a holding company that provides reinsurance and insurance services.  The
U.S. Reinsurance segment writes property and liability reinsurance as well as specialist lines of
business such as marine, aviation, surety, and accident and health through reinsurance brokers as
well as directly with ceding firms predominantly in the United States.

Claims and Billing are managed by [insuranceTPA][11], a health plan administrator.

As Low As $85/month

[Compare Plans][12]

[Pricing Based On Age And State Availability][13]

## **Short-Term Medical may not be for Everyone**

It’s important to know what’s not covered, so you can avoid any surprises if you are not the right
customer for this product, including but not limited to:
* Pre-existing conditions are not covered
* Dental and eye care are not covered
* Prescriptions (unless prescribed during a covered hospitalization) are not covered
* Like most health insurance plans, services are subject to Usual Customary and Reasonable (UCR)
  review to determine the Maximum Allowed Expense.

We want your plan to work for you. That’s why it’s also important to know that Everest Short-Term
Medical Insurance is not considered “minimal essential coverage” under the federal Affordable Care
Act.

# Why do I need travel protection from Allianz Partners?

## Because sometimes...

### You have to cancel a trip last-minute.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for your prepaid, non-refundable trip costs — including vacation
rentals, car rentals, hotels and flights — if you have to cancel for a covered reason.

### Travel delays leave you stranded.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for eligible meals, accommodation and transportation expenses
during a covered delay.

### You get sick or hurt when you're far from home.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for care following a covered medical emergency while traveling.
We can even arrange and pay for a medical evacuation if needed.

### Fender-benders are unavoidable.

Renting a car means taking on a big financial risk; even a tiny scrape can cost you hundreds.
Low-priced rental car insurance lets you drive worry-free.

### You need help in a hurry.

Whether you're planning a week-long road trip or a weekend getaway, you never know what might
happen. Travel insurance gives you access to our 24-Hour Assistance hotline for expert, personalized
support in a crisis.

## Comparing auto insurance quotes is easy

One of the best ways to save money on car insurance is to compare quotes. Prices can vary by
hundreds of dollars among companies, so time spent getting prices can really pay off.

It's easy to get quotes. EverQuote can match you to insurers that best fit you. And auto insurance
quotes are free - no matter who you get them from.

## Types of car insurance

It's good to have an idea of what kinds of auto insurance you want when you're ready to compare car
insurance quotes. Here are the main coverage types.

**Liability insurance.** This is required in most states and is the foundation of auto insurance
policies. Liability coverage pays others for accidents you cause, including injuries and property
damage. Note that liability insurance does not cover any damage to your own car.

**Collision insurance.** This pays for damage to your car if you hit something, such as a pole or
tree.

**Comprehensive insurance.** This pays out if your car is stolen. It also covers damage to you car
if you hit an animal or if you have damage from flood, fire, hail, vandalism or falling objects
(such as a tree branch).

**Uninsured motorist (UM) insurance.** If you're injured by a driver who has no liability insurance,
this coverage pays medical bills. In some states you can also buy a version that covers car damage
from an uninsured motorist.

**Personal injury protection (PIP) and medical payments (MedPay) coverage.** These pay for injuries
of you and your passengers, no matter who was at fault. Some states require PIP, where it is
sometimes called "no-fault insurance."

**Rental reimbursement insurance.** If your car is in the shop due to an accident covered by your
policy, this helps pay for a rental car. It typically has a daily and total maximum that it will
pay.

## How much auto insurance do you want?

Before you set out to compare car insurance, have an idea of what levels of coverage you want. The
minimum you must buy will be decided by your state. State requirements can include liability
insurance, uninsured motorist coverage, and personal injury protection (called PIP or no-fault). You
may want higher coverage levels for each than what's required.

Here are examples of levels of coverage for liability and uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage.
Your own car insurance needs often depend on how many assets you would have at risk in a lawsuit
against you after a car crash. It also depends on whether you want insurance that will pay out for
damage such as hail, hitting a fence or having your car stolen.

**Highest Level**
* $250,000 per person/ $500,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $100,000 property damage liability
* $250,000 per person/ $500,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Typical Level**
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $50,000 property damage liability
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Lower Level**
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $25,000 property damage liability
* $50,000 per person/ $100,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

**Minimum level (state requirements might be higher)**
* $15,000 per person / $30,000 per accident bodily injury liability
* $5,000 property damage liability
* $15,000 per person/ $30,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

* $50,000 property damage liability
* $100,000 per person/ $300,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

* $15,000 per person/ $30,000 per accident uninsured/underinsured motorist

## What's full coverage car insurance?

You may have heard the term "full coverage car insurance." It generally refers to a policy that has
liability, collision and comprehensive coverage. That gives you insurance for damage and injuries
you cause others (liability), and damage to your own car and theft (collision and comprehensive).

## How much will auto insurance cost?

The average premium paid for full coverage is about $138 a month, based on premiums reported by
EverQuote users. That's based on good drivers with the "typical" level of coverage shown above.

Of course you can spend less by buying less coverage, but you might regret it later if you're in an
accident.

## How car insurance quotes are calculated

Rates can vary quite a bit when you compare car insurance because insurance companies all have their
own way of calculating prices. Still, here are factors generally used in auto insurance quotes:

**The drivers.** Age and driving experience affect quotes. So do moving violations such as speeding
tickets. This includes all the licensed drivers in your household.

**Past claims and accidents.** Having caused accidents and made claims will usually mean higher
rates.

**How the vehicle is used and where it's parked. ** Do you use the vehicle for personal or business
reasons? Where is it parked at night? These typically affect car insurance quotes.

**Credit.** Poor credit can mean higher auto insurance rates. The insurance industry correlates poor
credit to a higher chance that a driver will make a claim. This practice is banned in California,
Hawaii and Massachusetts.

**The vehicle.** Insurers often use data on past claims on a vehicle like yours to calculate car
insurance quotes. If other drivers of your model have made a lot of claims, or the vehicle is
expensive to repair, that can be reflected in a car insurance quote.

###  
###

###

personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

# Why do I need travel protection from Allianz Partners?

## Because sometimes...

### You have to cancel a trip last-minute.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for your prepaid, non-refundable trip costs — including vacation
rentals, car rentals, hotels and flights — if you have to cancel for a covered reason.

### Travel delays leave you stranded.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for eligible meals, accommodation and transportation expenses
during a covered delay.

### You get sick or hurt when you're far from home.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for care following a covered medical emergency while traveling.
We can even arrange and pay for a medical evacuation if needed.

### Fender-benders are unavoidable.

Renting a car means taking on a big financial risk; even a tiny scrape can cost you hundreds.
Low-priced rental car insurance lets you drive worry-free.

### You need help in a hurry.

Whether you're planning a week-long road trip or a weekend getaway, you never know what might
happen. Travel insurance gives you access to our 24-Hour Assistance hotline for expert, personalized
support in a crisis.

# Why do I need travel protection from Allianz Partners?

## Because sometimes...

### You have to cancel a trip last-minute.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for your prepaid, non-refundable trip costs — including vacation
rentals, car rentals, hotels and flights — if you have to cancel for a covered reason.

### Travel delays leave you stranded.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for eligible meals, accommodation and transportation expenses
during a covered delay.

### You get sick or hurt when you're far from home.

Travel insurance can reimburse you for care following a covered medical emergency while traveling.
We can even arrange and pay for a medical evacuation if needed.

### Fender-benders are unavoidable.

Renting a car means taking on a big financial risk; even a tiny scrape can cost you hundreds.
Low-priced rental car insurance lets you drive worry-free.

### You need help in a hurry.

Whether you're planning a week-long road trip or a weekend getaway, you never know what might
happen. Travel insurance gives you access to our 24-Hour Assistance hotline for expert, personalized
support in a crisis.

# AncillaryOne – Unified API for Travel Ancillary Services

Integrate once, sell everything. AncillaryOne connects airlines, OTAs, and travel platforms to
eSIMs, lounges, refund protection, transfers, and more through a single API.

## Ancillary Services
* [eSIM Data Plans][1] – Global connectivity in 190+ countries
* [Refund Protection][2] – Turn non-refundable bookings into flexible options
* [Flight Tracking][3] – Real-time flight status with notifications
* [Carbon Offsetting][4] – Verified environmental offset projects
* [Private Transfers][5] – Airport and ground transportation
* [Tours & Activities][6] – Destination experiences and excursions
* [Lounge Access][7] – Airport lounge bookings worldwide
* [Flight Delay Compensation][8] – EU261 claims processing
* [Baggage Compensation][9] – Lost and delayed baggage claims

## Resources
* [Ancillary Revenue Calculator][10] – Estimate ancillary revenue uplift for travel sellers based on
  booking volume, attach rates, and margins. Ancillary revenue accounts for nearly 15% of airline
  income globally ($148B+).
* [Flight API Leaderboard][11] – Ranked comparison of major flight API providers (GDS, Aggregators,
  Metasearch) scored on coverage, NDC readiness, developer experience, ancillary depth, and market
  presence.
* [Hotel API Leaderboard][12] – Ranked comparison of major hotel API providers (Direct, Bedbank,
  Aggregator) including Booking.com, Expedia, Hotelbeds, Ratehawk, and more.
* [Monetisation Guide][13] – Comprehensive guide on how to make money selling travel ancillaries,
  covering business models, channels, tech stack, and unit economics.

## Thought Leadership
* [How MCP Servers Are Shaping Travel][14] – How Model Context Protocol is reshaping travel
  technology and AI accessibility.
* [NDC Players Shaping Airline Distribution][15] – Analysis of NDC implementation challenges and key
  players.
* [How Online Travel Agencies Make Money][16] – Revenue models and the future of OTAs in an AI-first
  world.

## Frequently asked questions

## What does Marsh do?

Marsh helps organizations navigate risk, develop their people, build their strategies to help them
thrive. With more than 95,000 colleagues in over 130 countries, we deliver expertise across risk,
reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting.

## What industries does Marsh serve?

We serve clients across a wide range of industries, including financial services, healthcare,
energy, manufacturing, construction, technology, retail, transportation, and the public sector.

## How is Marsh different from other professional services firms?

We bring together distinct capabilities across risk, strategy, and people. This means we can connect
data, insights, and solutions from across our firm to address our clients’ most complex challenges
and opportunities.

## I already work with one of your businesses. Can I access services from your other businesses?

Yes. Many of our clients work with multiple Marsh businesses to address interconnected challenges.
Your current team can introduce you to colleagues across Marsh.

## Is Marsh the same as Marsh McLennan?

Marsh McLennan changed its brand to Marsh effective January 2026. Marsh, our insurance broker, is
now known as Marsh Risk. Our other businesses will adopt the Marsh brand following a transition
period. This is a change to our brand strategy, not our business structure. We will continue to
serve clients as we do today across risk, strategy, and people.

## Is the stock ticker symbol changing?

Yes. Our stock ticker symbol changed from MMC to MRSH on the New York Stock Exchange in January
2026. [Learn more.][16]

# Mapa rizik EGAP

Barometr EGAP hodnotící rizikovost zemí vychází z komplexního interního hodnocení politické,
ekonomické a finanční situace země a může se lišit od oficiální kategorizace OECD. Zohledňuje nejen
suverénní riziko země, ale také platební zkušenosti EGAP a partnerských ECAs, rizika plynoucí ze
struktury ekonomiky, politické situace, právního, bezpečnostního a podnikatelského prostředí,
bankovního sektoru a další.

Suverénní riziko je riziko ministerstva financí (platební schopnost a vůle ze strany státu). ECAs
jsou exportní agentury jako EGAP v zemích OECD.

# Mapa rizik EGAP

Barometr EGAP hodnotící rizikovost zemí vychází z komplexního interního hodnocení politické,
ekonomické a finanční situace země a může se lišit od oficiální kategorizace OECD. Zohledňuje nejen
suverénní riziko země, ale také platební zkušenosti EGAP a partnerských ECAs, rizika plynoucí ze
struktury ekonomiky, politické situace, právního, bezpečnostního a podnikatelského prostředí,
bankovního sektoru a další.

Suverénní riziko je riziko ministerstva financí (platební schopnost a vůle ze strany státu). ECAs
jsou exportní agentury jako EGAP v zemích OECD.

# A Temporary Health Insurance Plan Is Easy To Obtain And Provides Coverage You Can Afford.

Don’t wait! Make an affordable choice and protect your health with Flex Term short-term medical

[START HERE][6]

# What Is Short-Term Health Insurance Used For?

Short-term health insurance is your *lifeline* during gaps in coverage—whether you’re between jobs,
transitioning off a parent’s plan, or waiting for open enrollment. The Flex Term Health Insurance
Plan offers you fast, flexible protection when you need it most.

With premiums designed to be budget-friendly, these plans deliver essential medical coverage without
breaking the bank.

Coverage can start as soon as tomorrow and you can cancel anytime without penalties. 

## Who Uses Temporary Health Insurance?
* Individuals who missed the deadlines for the ACA exchanges and need to wait until the next
  enrollment period
* Individuals who have a waiting period before enrollment in another program
* People who need health insurance in between jobs or have been laid off
* [People looking for a less expensive COBRA health insurance alternative][7]
* Those needing temporary coverage:
  * College students or recent graduates
  * Young adults coming off their parent’s health benefit plan
  * Retirees waiting for Medicare eligibility
  * Coverage for dependents not covered under an employer plan

#### Quick Coverage, Flexible Plans

Find short-term health insurance plans for less. Keep yourself safe with temporary health coverage.

[See Plans][8]
[Person looking at plans on a laptop][Person looking at plans on a laptop]

### Flex Term Health Insurance Plan Options²
* Deductible options ($1,000, $2,500, $5,000, $7,500, or $10,000)
* Co-pay : $50
* Co-insurance options (50/50, 70/30, 80/20, or 100/0)
* Coverage period maximum ($250,000, $750,000, $1,000,000, or $1,500,000)
* Length of coverage options
* Eligibility 18-64 years old (child only coverage for ages 2-25)
* Monthly or pre-pay payment options
* Free-look period

[Start Here][9]

Office Visit Copays Are $50

FlexTerm short-term health insurance is currently available in:
AL, AZ, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MS, MO, NE, NV, NC, OH, OK, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, VA, WV, WI, and
WY

## How Does Flex Term Temporary Health Insurance Work?

FIRST

 

$50 copay for physician office visit
$50 copay for annual wellness exam

THEN

 

Cover your deductible of $1000, $2500, $5000, $7500 or $10,000
Your deductible is the amount you must pay before FlexTerm Health Insurance pays benefits.

Coinsurance Options:
* 50%/50% – You pay 50% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 70%/30% – You pay 30% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 80%/20% – You pay 20% of any additional covered charges up to the plan maximum
* 100% – We pay 100% of the covered charges up to the plan maximum

AFTER

**FlexTerm Health pays all remaining covered charges, up to the Policy Period Maximum.**

## Flex Term Health Insurance Highlights
* Plans available up to 12 months*
* 5 minute simple applaication process
* Flexibility to choose your own physician and hospitals
* Next Day Coverage

* Some states may vary

[Provider Search][10]

## Summary of Coverages
* Wellness
* Inpatient/Outpatient Surgery
* Hospital Benefits
* Emergency Room Care
* Outpatient Services
* X-Ray and Laboratory
* Transplant Benefits
* Urgent Care
* Sickness

### About The Carrier

[Everest Reinsurance Company Logo 2022][Everest Reinsurance Company Logo 2022]

Everest Re Group Ltd. is a holding company that provides reinsurance and insurance services.  The
U.S. Reinsurance segment writes property and liability reinsurance as well as specialist lines of
business such as marine, aviation, surety, and accident and health through reinsurance brokers as
well as directly with ceding firms predominantly in the United States.

Claims and Billing are managed by [insuranceTPA][11], a health plan administrator.

As Low As $85/month

[Compare Plans][12]

[Pricing Based On Age And State Availability][13]

## **Short-Term Medical may not be for Everyone**

It’s important to know what’s not covered, so you can avoid any surprises if you are not the right
customer for this product, including but not limited to:
* Pre-existing conditions are not covered
* Dental and eye care are not covered
* Prescriptions (unless prescribed during a covered hospitalization) are not covered
* Like most health insurance plans, services are subject to Usual Customary and Reasonable (UCR)
  review to determine the Maximum Allowed Expense.

We want your plan to work for you. That’s why it’s also important to know that Everest Short-Term
Medical Insurance is not considered “minimal essential coverage” under the federal Affordable Care
Act.

# Health Insurance for Digital Nomads

Every country. Any doctor or hospital. We've got you covered.

[Get covered][7][Travelers love us[Rating]on[Trustpilot]][8]

## Explore the world

No need to tell us where you're going. Just go. We've got you covered.

## Take care of your health

We cover necessary medical treatment. 24/7 emergency assistance hotline.

## Choose any doctor

We cover treatment at every licensed healthcare provider worldwide.

## We make it easy

Get an instant price and sign up online, even if you're already abroad.

[Get covered][9]

## We're here when you need us
* Scooter crash in Thailand
* Dengue fever in Bali
* Ear infection in Vietnam
* Surfing accident in South Africa
* Broken foot in Spain
* COVID-19 in Colombia

[stay genki]

## Easy as pie

### Doctor's visit?
1. Visit doctor
2. Send claim form
3. Paid within 2 weeks
4. Get well soon

### Hospital stay?
1. Go to hospital
2. They call hotline
3. We pay hospital
4. Get well soon

## Dive deeper

We offer two types of health insurance for digital nomads. You can dive into all the details below.
[Compare both options][10]
[Travel health insurance][11][International health insurance][12]

We're here to help.

## Global Travel Insurance

We are an independent family run insurance broker business and have been specialising in providing
travel insurance since 1997.

As a specialist travel insurance broker, it is our job to offer you the right policy for your needs
which is why we have put together a carefully selected range of products from a range of insurance
providers.

Having reviewed the range of products available, if you are unsure about which policy is best for
you, or just want some guidance, or would prefer to arrange your policy over the telephone, call us
on **01903 235042 **and speak to one of our experienced technicians.   

If you are happy to obtain a quotation without assistance from our technicians, **[CLICK
HERE][19]** to go straight to the list of products, or use the **GET A QUOTE** button wherever it
appears. 

You will be automatically directed to the site operated and fulfilled by the insurance provider.
Quotations and Policy documents will be available to you in electronic format only and sent by
email.

 

Take the risk out of buying travel insurance.

**You can TRUST in GLOBAL TRAVEL INSURANCE!**

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

2024.

# The home for 
# non-standard insurance

[Find out more][43]
[Make a claim][44]

Haven provides short term and annual insurance policies to suit a wide range of non-standard needs.
We specialise in helping clients find cover when they have struggled to obtain insurance elsewhere.

#### Insures over 500,000 policyholders

#### Solvency Cover Ratio in excess of 170%

#### Short term and annual cover

#### Over £550m+ paid out in claims last year

What we do

## As a specialist in non-standard insurance, Haven has built a reputation on developing products
## outside of the mainstream motor and household markets.

As well as dedicated products for private household and motor, we also offer public and private hire
insurance, fleet, motor trade, minibus and commercial vehicle insurance. In addition to the
traditional annual insurance policy, we offer temporary motor insurance covering a number of
different requirements.

Haven products are available throughout the UK, both online and via the offices of our partners
including [Acorn Insurance & Financial Services Ltd][45], [Carrot][46], [Motorcade][47], [Flag][48],
[Rapid][49], [Street Cover][50] and [Briefly][51].

### Haven is constantly evolving, expanding, and developing new products.

Haven is a proud member of the Acorn Group, one of the UK’s largest non-standard motor insurance
companies.

## Visiting Ukraine in 2026: Entry Rules, Border Access & Insurance Tips

Planning a trip to Ukraine in 2026? Despite martial law, entry is allowed and safe through land
borders. Here's what you need to know:

#### Entry Requirements for Foreign Visitors

You can legally enter Ukraine if you:
* Have a valid passport (must be valid for your entire stay; citizens of Turkey and Georgia can
  enter with a national ID card);
* Hold a health insurance policy (mandatory for most travelers, especially media and public figures
  — as required by Ukrainian law);
* Have a visa (unless your country has a visa-free agreement with Ukraine);
* Can prove the purpose of your visit (e.g. tourism, business, volunteering);
* Can show sufficient financial means for your stay and return;
* Are not subject to an entry ban by Ukrainian authorities.

Note: Ukrainian residence permits that expired after February 24, 2022 remain valid during martial
law and for 30 days after its end (this does not apply to citizens of the Russian Federation).

#### Visa & Border Information for 2026

Citizens of many countries (including the EU, UK, US, and Canada) can enter Ukraine visa-free for up
to 90 days within a 180-day period. Others will need to obtain a visa through a consulate or the
e-visa system. You can check your visa status on the Insurance Ukraine website by selecting your
nationality. Ukraine's borders remain open with Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, and Moldova.
Border crossings with Russia, Belarus, and Transnistria are closed. Always check updated border
crossing hours, queues, and lists of prohibited items before traveling.

#### Health Insurance Advice for Ukraine

Travelers are strongly advised to purchase medical insurance with war risk coverage for the entire
duration of their stay. This type of policy typically covers:
* Emergency medical care
* Outpatient treatment and hospitalization
* War-related injuries and passive war risks
* Repatriation (in case of injury or death)

# Loggers Broad Form Insurance and more...

#### Loggers Broad Form Insurance from Athena Insurance since 1996. Steve Valencia Broker

# We're experts

You have come to the correct web site if you are seeking a dedicated licensed agent and broker.
Athena Insurance and Financial Services has been servicing insured's needs since 1996 with
everything from life insurance to loggers broad form insurance.  Experience matters!

##### **Loggers Broad form third party fire suppression liability****
##### **

We offer Loggers Broad Form Liabilitin on a stand-alone basis. Please understand, you are required
to “have” General Liability to obtain Loggers Broad Form. 

We can provide you with both Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. But, if you already have
General Liability we will “consider” writing the Loggers Broad Form for your. 

The concern for us is that your General Liability coveres the classes of opertaions related to why
you are needing the loggers broad form. 

We highly recommend having us write both the Loggers Broad Form and General Liability. 

[ Quote Logger Broad Form Now][26]

##### **Inland Marine & logging equipment & misc. tools
##### **

Inland Marine Insurance is available on a “stand-alone” basis for qualified prospects and clients.  

Eligibility will depend on a number of factors such as proof of prior coverage, claim experience
history, number of pieces of equipment, geographic and more. 

What do we need to quote? We need an Inland Marine intake form. You may submit one at your leisure
of call us and we will complete one for you. 

We must have the following: Year Make, model, serial number, current market value and loss payee
name & address.



[ Quote Inland Marine Coverage][27]

##### **Commercial Auto & Transportation
##### **

Single vehicles to fleets. Heavy duty trucks to log haulers we provide services to nearly all States
in the U.S. 

Options may include “Excess” liability, non-owne auto, drive – other car, hire auto and more. 

Personal auto has  exclusions. We will review your current policy and point out the potential
pitt-falls of your current coverage. 

State and Federal Filings are availble for most operations.  

Additional Insured Certificates and other options may be provided including optional endorsements
such as Waiver of Subrogation and Primay Wording. 



[ Quote Commercial Auto now][28]

The program is designed to provide agents and insureds with a workers' compensation option tailored to the operational and claims characteristics of the temporary staffing industry. The program is available for qualifying staffing operations and is subject to underwriting eligibility, state availability, and policy terms and conditions. ## Program Targets Temporary Staffing Risks According to the companies, the program was developed to address the complexities temporary staffing firms face, including changing employee assignments and varied client worksites. Jennifer Burnham, divisional vice president of Great American Alternative Markets, said temporary staffing firms need workers' compensation carriers that understand the industry's unique operational challenges. She said the program combines Great American's underwriting and claims capabilities for program business with CoEfficient's staffing-focused technical expertise and risk-management approach to serve qualified temporary-staffing accounts. Jeff Nacyk, president of CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., said the company is pleased to work with Great American's Alternative Markets Division to bring a workers' compensation solution to the temporary staffing market. He said the staffing industry requires disciplined underwriting, responsive claims management, and risk control support that reflects the realities of a constantly changing workforce. He added that the companies believe the program provides agents and qualified staffing firms with a service-oriented option for managing workers' compensation exposures. ## Distribution and Availability The program is available through CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., along with its appointed retail agents and brokers. Coverage availability, terms, conditions, limits, and exclusions vary by state and by account characteristics. ## About Alternative Markets Great American's Alternative Markets Division specializes in niche program business through both risk-sharing and traditional program options. Its product offerings include workers' compensation in all 50 states, along with general liability, package, business owners policy, property, auto, and umbrella coverage. Programs range from monoline to multiline and may be offered with bundled or unbundled services. The division supports program underwriting, marketing, claims, actuarial, product development, information technology, and operations services. Policies are underwritten by Great American Insurance Company, Great American Assurance Company, Great American Alliance Insurance Company, and Great American Spirit Insurance Company, all authorized insurers in all 50 states and Washington, D.C. **Company Background** [Great American Insurance Group][22] traces its history to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. ## Health plans for life's moments

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

Coverage is unique to each health plan. Many plans may cover things like preventive care,

until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.

reimburse you for non-refundable expenses, cover emergency medical expenses, and even help with
things like missing connections or stolen passports. In short, it can help you travel with peace of
mind—knowing you’re covered, wherever the road (or sky) takes you.

# Health insurance plans

## Health plans for life's moments

Our plans are made to deliver what matters, from quality coverage to caring support. Find a plan or

more.

goals.

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

### What does health insurance cover?

until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.

# AncillaryOne – Unified API for Travel Ancillary Services

Integrate once, sell everything. AncillaryOne connects airlines, OTAs, and travel platforms to
eSIMs, lounges, refund protection, transfers, and more through a single API.

## Ancillary Services
* [eSIM Data Plans][1] – Global connectivity in 190+ countries
* [Refund Protection][2] – Turn non-refundable bookings into flexible options
* [Flight Tracking][3] – Real-time flight status with notifications
* [Carbon Offsetting][4] – Verified environmental offset projects
* [Private Transfers][5] – Airport and ground transportation
* [Tours & Activities][6] – Destination experiences and excursions
* [Lounge Access][7] – Airport lounge bookings worldwide
* [Flight Delay Compensation][8] – EU261 claims processing
* [Baggage Compensation][9] – Lost and delayed baggage claims

## Resources
* [Ancillary Revenue Calculator][10] – Estimate ancillary revenue uplift for travel sellers based on
  booking volume, attach rates, and margins. Ancillary revenue accounts for nearly 15% of airline
  income globally ($148B+).
* [Flight API Leaderboard][11] – Ranked comparison of major flight API providers (GDS, Aggregators,
  Metasearch) scored on coverage, NDC readiness, developer experience, ancillary depth, and market
  presence.
* [Hotel API Leaderboard][12] – Ranked comparison of major hotel API providers (Direct, Bedbank,
  Aggregator) including Booking.com, Expedia, Hotelbeds, Ratehawk, and more.
* [Monetisation Guide][13] – Comprehensive guide on how to make money selling travel ancillaries,
  covering business models, channels, tech stack, and unit economics.

## Thought Leadership
* [How MCP Servers Are Shaping Travel][14] – How Model Context Protocol is reshaping travel
  technology and AI accessibility.
* [NDC Players Shaping Airline Distribution][15] – Analysis of NDC implementation challenges and key
  players.
* [How Online Travel Agencies Make Money][16] – Revenue models and the future of OTAs in an AI-first
  world.

## Frequently asked questions

## What does Marsh do?

Marsh helps organizations navigate risk, develop their people, build their strategies to help them
thrive. With more than 95,000 colleagues in over 130 countries, we deliver expertise across risk,
reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting.

## What industries does Marsh serve?

We serve clients across a wide range of industries, including financial services, healthcare,
energy, manufacturing, construction, technology, retail, transportation, and the public sector.

## How is Marsh different from other professional services firms?

We bring together distinct capabilities across risk, strategy, and people. This means we can connect
data, insights, and solutions from across our firm to address our clients’ most complex challenges
and opportunities.

## I already work with one of your businesses. Can I access services from your other businesses?

Yes. Many of our clients work with multiple Marsh businesses to address interconnected challenges.
Your current team can introduce you to colleagues across Marsh.

## Is Marsh the same as Marsh McLennan?

Marsh McLennan changed its brand to Marsh effective January 2026. Marsh, our insurance broker, is
now known as Marsh Risk. Our other businesses will adopt the Marsh brand following a transition
period. This is a change to our brand strategy, not our business structure. We will continue to
serve clients as we do today across risk, strategy, and people.

## Is the stock ticker symbol changing?

Yes. Our stock ticker symbol changed from MMC to MRSH on the New York Stock Exchange in January
2026. [Learn more.][16]

# Mapa rizik EGAP

Barometr EGAP hodnotící rizikovost zemí vychází z komplexního interního hodnocení politické,
ekonomické a finanční situace země a může se lišit od oficiální kategorizace OECD. Zohledňuje nejen
suverénní riziko země, ale také platební zkušenosti EGAP a partnerských ECAs, rizika plynoucí ze
struktury ekonomiky, politické situace, právního, bezpečnostního a podnikatelského prostředí,
bankovního sektoru a další.

Suverénní riziko je riziko ministerstva financí (platební schopnost a vůle ze strany státu). ECAs
jsou exportní agentury jako EGAP v zemích OECD.

# Mapa rizik EGAP

Barometr EGAP hodnotící rizikovost zemí vychází z komplexního interního hodnocení politické,
ekonomické a finanční situace země a může se lišit od oficiální kategorizace OECD. Zohledňuje nejen
suverénní riziko země, ale také platební zkušenosti EGAP a partnerských ECAs, rizika plynoucí ze
struktury ekonomiky, politické situace, právního, bezpečnostního a podnikatelského prostředí,
bankovního sektoru a další.

Suverénní riziko je riziko ministerstva financí (platební schopnost a vůle ze strany státu). ECAs
jsou exportní agentury jako EGAP v zemích OECD.

travel insurance since 1997.

As a specialist travel insurance broker, it is our job to offer you the right policy for your needs
which is why we have put together a carefully selected range of products from a range of insurance
providers.

Having reviewed the range of products available, if you are unsure about which policy is best for
you, or just want some guidance, or would prefer to arrange your policy over the telephone, call us

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

# The home for 
# non-standard insurance

[Find out more][43]
[Make a claim][44]

Haven provides short term and annual insurance policies to suit a wide range of non-standard needs.
We specialise in helping clients find cover when they have struggled to obtain insurance elsewhere.

#### Insures over 500,000 policyholders

#### Solvency Cover Ratio in excess of 170%

#### Short term and annual cover

#### Over £550m+ paid out in claims last year

What we do

## As a specialist in non-standard insurance, Haven has built a reputation on developing products
## outside of the mainstream motor and household markets.

As well as dedicated products for private household and motor, we also offer public and private hire
insurance, fleet, motor trade, minibus and commercial vehicle insurance. In addition to the
traditional annual insurance policy, we offer temporary motor insurance covering a number of
different requirements.

Haven products are available throughout the UK, both online and via the offices of our partners
including [Acorn Insurance & Financial Services Ltd][45], [Carrot][46], [Motorcade][47], [Flag][48],
[Rapid][49], [Street Cover][50] and [Briefly][51].

### Haven is constantly evolving, expanding, and developing new products.

Haven is a proud member of the Acorn Group, one of the UK’s largest non-standard motor insurance
companies.

distributors. Our team brings an unmatched level of healthcare expertise to serve you. We partner

you with tailored health insurance solutions that align with your unique requirements. Our
commitment to your well-being drives us to continually enhance our offerings.

Pivot Health is not your average insurance company. We bring together a multitude of products and

[Sign Up to Receive Updates Straight to Your Inbox][21] [Great American, CoEfficient Launch Workers’ Compensation Program for Temporary Staffing Firms] # Great American, CoEfficient Launch Workers’ Compensation Program for Temporary Staffing Firms Great American Insurance Group's Alternative Markets Division and CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc. have introduced a new workers' compensation program for temporary staffing firms. The program is designed to provide agents and insureds with a workers' compensation option tailored to the operational and claims characteristics of the temporary staffing industry. The program is available for qualifying staffing operations and is subject to underwriting eligibility, state availability, and policy terms and conditions. ## Program Targets Temporary Staffing Risks According to the companies, the program was developed to address the complexities temporary staffing firms face, including changing employee assignments and varied client worksites. Jennifer Burnham, divisional vice president of Great American Alternative Markets, said temporary staffing firms need workers' compensation carriers that understand the industry's unique operational challenges. She said the program combines Great American's underwriting and claims capabilities for program business with CoEfficient's staffing-focused technical expertise and risk-management approach to serve qualified temporary-staffing accounts. Jeff Nacyk, president of CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., said the company is pleased to work with Great American's Alternative Markets Division to bring a workers' compensation solution to the temporary staffing market. He said the staffing industry requires disciplined underwriting, responsive claims management, and risk control support that reflects the realities of a constantly changing workforce. He added that the companies believe the program provides agents and qualified staffing firms with a service-oriented option for managing workers' compensation exposures. ## Distribution and Availability The program is available through CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc., along with its appointed retail agents and brokers. Coverage availability, terms, conditions, limits, and exclusions vary by state and by account characteristics. ## About Alternative Markets Great American's Alternative Markets Division specializes in niche program business through both risk-sharing and traditional program options. Its product offerings include workers' compensation in all 50 states, along with general liability, package, business owners policy, property, auto, and umbrella coverage. Programs range from monoline to multiline and may be offered with bundled or unbundled services. The division supports program underwriting, marketing, claims, actuarial, product development, information technology, and operations services. Policies are underwritten by Great American Insurance Company, Great American Assurance Company, Great American Alliance Insurance Company, and Great American Spirit Insurance Company, all authorized insurers in all 50 states and Washington, D.C. **Company Background** [Great American Insurance Group][22] traces its history to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. Based in Cincinnati, the organization focuses primarily on specialized commercial property and casualty insurance products for businesses. The company said Great American Insurance Company has maintained an AM Best rating of "A" (Excellent) or higher for more than 115 years and currently holds an "A+" (Superior) rating. Great American Insurance Group companies are subsidiaries of American Financial Group Inc., which is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol AFG. CoEfficient Underwriters Agency, Inc. is a program administrator specializing in workers' compensation, independent contractor products, captive design

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

### What does health insurance cover?

Coverage is unique to each health plan. Many plans may cover things like preventive care,
prescription drugs, hospital stays, mental health services and more. A plan may cover the full cost
of certain services, or you may have to share costs (by paying a copay or coinsurance, for example)
until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.

[Learn how to review a Summary of Benefits and Coverage][29]
[Learn more about health insurance][30]
[Get the facts about how the health system works][31]

## Working to make the health care experience better

UnitedHealthcare puts care at the heart of health insurance. Empathy, transparency and human
connection guide us. Because better care comes from understanding what people need — and making
quality care more personal.

## Health plans for life's moments

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.
